architecture.mechanism: Accelerometers detect impact-induced structural waves in rotor blades, with sensor feasibility assessed using signal-to-noise ratios and cross-correlations.
architecture.intervention: Install salt-protected capacitive accelerometers at multiple blade stations to identify ice accretion or shedding signatures and activate localized anti-icing only when validated thresholds are exceeded.
architecture.expected_effect: Earlier localized ice detection without continuous heating or aerodynamic protrusions, helping preserve rotor balance and winter power output.
architecture.falsification_test: Expose instrumented blade coupons to salt spray and high-wind cycling, then add and release calibrated ice masses to determine whether sensor cross-correlation and signal-to-noise data reliably detect ice before power-curve degradation.
